address: Unit 1&2 J-Shed, Kings Road, Swansea, SA1 8PL, United Kingdom
bio: Experienced Chef-Owner Jonathan Woolway worked in London for many years before returning home to his beloved Wales to open this industrial-style restaurant by the former docks. His patriotic side comes out in the use of terrific local produce, along with a none-more-Welsh lamb, leek and laverbread pie to share. The other dishes too, from Mangalitsa brawn to a Welsh rarebit on the side, are hearty, traditional and decidedly unfussy....
